request: Build an editable source-argument lesson assessing whether the producer promised that every episode would be live. Require the exact relevant quote, attribution and a bounded conclusion.
objective: Preserve negation scope and speaker attribution when testing a claim against a short transcript.

sources.text: Fictional radio transcript: Host: “Will every episode be broadcast live?” Producer: “I did not promise that every episode would be live. Some interviews may be recorded earlier.”
A publicity draft written by an assistant says: “Every episode will be live, according to the producer.” The draft contains no additional interview or signed approval.
The production sheet labels the first episode live. It gives no formats for the remaining episodes.
